parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The list of resource IDs. Maximum number of list elements: 50.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The type of the resource. Set this value to **DOMAIN**.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags. Maximum number of list elements: 20.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cdn tag-resources --resource-type DOMAIN --resource-id example.com --tag Value=value Key=env --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cdn TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'example.com' --Tag.1.Key env --Tag.1.Value value --ResourceType DOMAIN
